title: Execution Ledger for a Pipeline Run
description: analysis/execution-ledger.json. THE canonical cross-runner counting model for one run (IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN task group 2.2a). Raw Playwright/Newman reports are evidence INPUTS, not the source of truth: they disagree about what a 'test' is, they lose timed-out and interrupted results, and they are secret-bearing. The ledger normalizes every runner into one mutually exclusive outcome per unit, keeps approved-case coverage separate from runner-unit totals, and records provenance so an unverified result can never read as a pass. Produced by execution adapters through the shared normalizer; consumed by the Failure Classifier, the Reporter, and the TestLink execution sync. Sanitized: it must never carry raw request/response bodies, headers, or injected secrets (docs/secrets-management.md).

schema_version.description: This artifact's own version, independent of the context/failure-analysis/release-report versions.

approved_scope_digest.description: Digest of the approved test-case scope this ledger was built against, so a ledger cannot be silently reused for a different scope. Null only when no approved scope existed at generation time; a null digest means coverage claims are unverified.

source_executions.description: One entry per runner invocation. Missing provenance means UNVERIFIED evidence, never a pass.

execution_id.description: Unique within this ledger. Units reference it.

command_identity.description: How the runner was invoked, WITHOUT secret values (never the resolved --env-var, never a header value).

process_status.description: Did the process itself produce trustworthy evidence? 'errored' and 'not_started' mean its units are blocked, not failed.

report_reference.description: Path to the sanitized report this was normalized from. The RAW reporter output stays local and is never referenced as published evidence.

source_errors.description: Run-level errors (global setup failure, collection load error). These are counted separately and NEVER given invented test identities.

units.description: One entry per executable unit. Retries are ATTEMPTS of the same unit, never separate units.

identity.description: Runner-native identity. Playwright: reporter test identity + project + repeat index. Newman: collection + request + iteration. External/manual: TC identity + occurrence.

domain_links.description: Proven-from-metadata domain IDs. An ID is null WITH a reason when it cannot be proven — IDs are NEVER derived from failure ordering (review finding B6).

unresolved_reason.description: REQUIRED whenever any link above is null. Names why the link could not be proven.

outcome.description: Exactly one, mutually exclusive. 'blocked' covers missing trustworthy results, interruptions, and setup errors that prevent a result. 'expected_failure' is a declared expected failure, never passing coverage.

attempts.description: Retry attempts of THIS unit. A final success after failure is outcome 'flaky'.

error_message.description: Sanitized excerpt only. Never raw request/response data.

assertions.description: Newman assertion evidence NESTED in its request unit — never additional units. A request with zero business assertions is 'blocked', even when HTTP transport succeeded.

case_outcomes.description: Approved-scope coverage, kept SEPARATE from runner units (the plan's counting clarification). An approved case with no executable unit is 'not_run' here and does NOT create an invented unit or inflate unit totals.

linked_unit_ids.description: Units that positively link to this case. Coverage is derived ONLY from positive links; an unlinked execution can never supply a pass.

totals.description: Counts MUST equal the sum of mutually exclusive unit outcomes. Run-level errors are counted separately and never folded into unit totals.

unit_pass_rate.description: Strictly passing units / all units in scope. NULL for zero units — never 0, never 1. Flaky and expected_failure are displayed separately and never counted as passing coverage.

approved_case_coverage.description: Cases with a positively linked passing outcome / approved cases. Reported SEPARATELY from unit_pass_rate: a nonempty approved scope with zero executed units has no passing coverage even though its unit pass rate is null.
